strings: Standardized vehicle diagnostic and safety checklists

Comprehensive bumper-to-bumper
evaluation covering engine systems,
suspension geometry, and road-worthiness.

High-throughput express bay checklist
targeting fluid levels, pan torque specs, filter
validation, and wiper wear.

Class-4 technician protocol: cell impedance
balancing, busbar torque verification, cooling
loop integrity, and isolation metrics.

Federal DOT baseline alignment, lift-gate
hydraulics, cargo tie-down certification, and
telematics hardware handshake.

Digital micrometer rotor depth checks, pad
thickness logging, caliper slide pin friction
testing, and tie rod lash measurement.

Assemble a bespoke diagnostic flow with
custom thresholds, required imagery, and
instant technician triggers.
Checklist changes require Master Inspector sign-off before field deployment.
